products.title: The Boundaries Edit
products.summary: Practice setting limits that protect your time and energy.

products.title: Becoming Her
products.summary: Picture the life you want and take one small step toward it.

prompts.title: Start with what you know
prompts.question: When do you feel most like yourself? Describe a recent moment.

prompts.title: Notice what goes unsaid
prompts.question: What have you been holding back? What would help you say it?

prompts.title: Practice asking for what you need
prompts.question: Write one sentence that communicates a need clearly and kindly.

prompts.title: Take one small step
prompts.question: Where could you use your voice this week? What will you do first?

prompts.title: Recognize your limits
prompts.question: Describe a recent moment when you agreed to something you wanted to decline.

prompts.title: Make it clear
prompts.question: Write a short, kind response you could use the next time this happens.

prompts.title: Imagine an ordinary day
prompts.question: What does an ordinary morning look like in the life you want?

prompts.title: Choose a next step
prompts.question: What is one action you can take this week to move toward that vision?
